summary_en: UCHIDA YOKO announced a dividend of 76 yen per share for the fiscal year ended July 2026, up 4 yen from the prior forecast of 72 yen, and introduced a progressive dividend policy from fiscal 2027 whereby dividends will be maintained or increased as a baseline, independent of short-term earnings fluctuations.
title_en: Notice Regarding Surplus Dividend Payment and Changes to Dividend Policy (Introduction of Progressive Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
UCHIDA YOKO announced a dividend of 76 yen per share for the fiscal year ended July 2026, an increase of 4 yen from the prior forecast of 72 yen published on June 3, 2026. The dividend will be paid from retained earnings with an effective date of October 14, 2026. The company's earnings significantly exceeded initial expectations, driving this increase.

Effective from fiscal 2027 (year ended July 2027), the company adopted a progressive dividend policy as a core principle. Under this policy, dividends will be maintained or increased as a baseline approach, independent of short-term earnings volatility. This change reflects the company's commitment to continuous and stable dividend payments to shareholders as a top management priority. The policy maintains the foundational principle of balancing financial soundness, long-term strategic investment, and shareholder returns while targeting sustained long-term value creation.

The dividend payment and the new dividend policy are subject to approval at the ordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for October 10, 2026.
